method: Six independent metered DeepSpace CLI requests to anthropic/chat-completion. Each request contained one 560 × 560 stage PNG and the same open-ended prompt, without the cue, filename, answer options or chat history. One call per image. Durations include CLI startup and network time. Cues and human assessments were attached after capture. This is a provider check, not a signed-in round or an accuracy estimate for player-created poses.

config.prompt: You are watching silent charades. What physical action is the performer acting out? Give one best guess as a short English phrase, at most twelve words. If the action is unclear, say "unclear".
